description: This file contains JUnit integration tests (CountIT class) for counting 'things' in a persistence layer, focusing on complex search criteria and authorization considerations within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: CountIT
classes.description: JUnit test class for counting 'things' with specific criteria in the persistence layer, including authorization aspects.

methods.name: countAny
methods.description: Tests counting all entities matching 'any' criteria with authorization.

methods.name: countAnyWithoutAuthorization
methods.description: Tests that count returns zero when no authorization is granted.

methods.name: countEquals
methods.description: Tests counting entities with a specific attribute value.

methods.name: countWithNoMatchingResults
methods.description: Tests counting when no matching entities exist.

methods.name: countIgnoresDeletedThings
methods.description: Ensures deleted entities are not included in count results.

methods.name: insertThingWithAttribute
methods.description: Utility method to insert a thing with specified attributes.

methods.name: getPolicyEnforcer
methods.description: Overrides to return different policy enforcers based on namespace.

methods.name: createOtherPolicy
methods.description: Creates a dummy policy for testing purposes.

methods.name: executeCount
methods.description: Executes a count operation based on criteria.
